LanguageData.SH.AllowCorpsesTooltip: Default Off. Only carry those directly in hands instead.
LanguageData.SH.AllowAnimals: Allow tamed pack animals to use inventory
LanguageData.SH.AllowAnimalsTooltip: Default On. Works best with mods that give backpacks to animals.
LanguageData.SH.AllowMechanoidsTooltip: Requires What The Hack or similar. Default On.
LanguageData.SH.MinFreeInventoryTooltip: Pawns with less free space will use vanilla hauling. Default 20%
LanguageData.SH.ShowHaulOverlayTooltip: Shows underline under items being hauled.
LanguageData.SH.ShowPawnNameTooltip: Shows the name of the pawn hauling each item.
LanguageData.SH.OverlayAllFactionsTooltip: If disabled, only shows for your colonists.
LanguageData.SH.NotifyOtherPawnsTooltip: When inventory full, notify nearby idle pawns to help.
LanguageData.SH.SmartCleanupTooltip: If hauling priority is lower than current work — drop at feet instead of going to storage.
LanguageData.SH.DropWhenHaulingDisabledTooltip: If hauling is disabled — drop collected items. Otherwise keep in inventory.
LanguageData.SH.RespectWorkPriorityTooltip: If OFF — always haul to storage. If ON — may drop at feet.
LanguageData.SH.DropNearStorageTooltip: When storage is full, try to carry items to the last position where this item type was successfully stored. If disabled, items are dropped at pawn's feet.
